question: What is the name of the device for measuring some characteristics of a liquid, such as its density or specific gravity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hydrometer.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A **hydrometer **is a device for measuring some characteristics of a liquid, such as its density or specific gravity.
 
• It works on the Archimedes principle.
 
• It is used to know the (specific) density of the fluid.
 
• The lower the density of the fluid, the more the hydrometer will sink.
